purpose: Prospective seven-zone validation of two frozen action doses before observing any Sebring LICO outcome.

sessions.objective: Collect two repetitions of each zone dose and three interleaved push controls.
sessions.lico_variation_guidance: Frozen P/A/B/P/B/A/P. A and B stagger the larger action across zones; neither is globally the stronger lap. Release fully at the beep, then brake normally. No intentional LICO on push laps or at T5/T16.
sessions.execution_quality_notes: Retain every lap and annotate errors by lap, turn and phase. Do not replace a scheduled lap or alter the plan mid-run. Native DuckDB plus LICOR event and telemetry logs required.
sessions.notes: Same Oreca LMP2; 55 L at pit departure, zero tyre wear, constant driver-controlled weather and unchanged setup. Seven cues per LICO lap, 28 expected. Calibration scored laps2/3, fixed held-out scored laps5/6; references from prior push run for transfer benchmark. No online adaptation.
